sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed action by WA Police following concerns about prosecution standards raised in an earlier report on an arrest at Hamilton Hill.
sentences.support: This report considers the actions taken by the WA Police Force in response to the concerns raised in the initial report.

sentences.text: The review considered organisational changes and a statewide examination of prosecuting services, including brief quality and prosecutor experience.
sentences.support: The Prosecuting Services Division advised that a number of preliminary findings had been identified.

sentences.text: The Commission recognised progress but remained cautious about effectiveness because the statewide review findings had not been endorsed or published.
sentences.support: the Commission remains cautious as to the effectiveness of such actions in addressing future risks.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that WA Police was taking appropriate action and closed its review.
sentences.support: The Commission considers the WA Police Force is taking appropriate steps and considers this review to be complete.

findings.quote: The Commission considers the WA Police Force is taking appropriate steps and considers this review to be complete.

notes: No separate executive summary or equivalent consolidated summary was identified. Preliminary findings of the police review are distinguished from the Commission's conclusions.
